name: Local SEO Lesson - Introduction to Local SEO
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A one-page orientation to the rank-and-rent track of the course. It lists what the author believes drives the Google map pack.

# Key concepts (as listed)
- NAP consistency, and NAP plus a Google Maps iframe embed on pages that mention the business.
- Reviews.
- Having a Google Business Profile location at all.
- Vicinity: how close the listing is to the searcher.
- Number of direction requests (how often people ask Google for directions to the listing).
- The lesson shows a screenshot contrasting the local (map pack) results with organic results.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Proximity and reviews are real ranking factors; direction counts are an engagement signal that should come from real customers, not manufactured traffic.
- TAG client NAP checks must respect intentional tracking numbers (see [WhatConverts](lib:brain-whatconverts) and [GoHighLevel](lib:brain-gohighlevel)).
